input.goal: Maintain health with tolerable risk, improve personal and shared life, understand unknowns, develop reusable abilities and honor freely accepted commitments. Choose, revise, pause or abandon your own projects using actual evidence. No specific invention or social arrangement is required.

interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
interfaces.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Hand-mash food
interfaces.function: Turn owned unspoiled roots and berries into divisible food while preserving actual ingredients, mass, nutrients and shortest remaining spoilage budget.
interfaces.costs: 1–4 original units; ceil(mass/0.4) work rounds, 1 energy each. Start pays first round, continuing start resumes bound work. Explicit continue resumes paused work. One output portion represents 0.1 original units; eat an actual number of portions. Soft carrying burden counts escrow and equal output mass; no hard inventory cap exists.
interfaces.effects: Cold preparation only: no detoxification, preservation, bonus nutrition or preparation reward. Cancel returns surviving escrow once, death drops it. Actual eat uses ingredient-weighted ordinary meals.

execution.progress: Persistent processId, completed/remaining work, paid energy, ingredients and output IDs; changing action pauses without refund.

shown.function: Create an oriented traversable 2 by 2 roof with three physical posts from actual branches, vines and bark; use, repair and dismantle its persistent components.

members.name: Cedar 1
members.intention: Establish a food reserve and inspect available abilities.

personalIntent.goal: Secure safe food and discover available capabilities.
personalIntent.reason: Roots are known safe; public capability discovery requires the meeting location.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, eat one, then consult the capability index.

shown: Root nutrition is 14 with zero known toxicity.
Use a separate root source from other members.

members.name: Cedar 2
members.intention: Prepare one root as a real portioning trial, retaining the other root.

personalIntent.goal: Test practical food portioning while retaining a safe root reserve.
personalIntent.reason: Hand-mashing is mastered, and two safe roots are owned; its actual output has not yet been experienced.
personalIntent.progress: Mastered prepare-food at tick 6. Health is full and satiety is 88.6.
personalIntent.next: Hand-mash one root and inspect the completed process before choosing an intake quantity.

shown.question: Can hand-mashing provide useful divisible portions of the existing safe food?
evidence: Two roots are owned at tick 6.
The contract preserves ingredients and nutrition but provides no preservation or detoxification.
shown.uncertainty: No preparation output or portioned meal has yet been observed.
shown.goal: Prepare a real batch and evaluate its usable portions without consuming the entire reserve.
shown.missing: A completed physical batch and its actual output identifiers.

shown: One root remains outside the trial.
Cold preparation does not improve nutrition or extend spoilage.

processing.waterComposition: Unrepresented water fraction; no drying or water removal occurs.

members.name: Cedar 3
members.intention: Use a small local material trial rather than assume construction suitability.

personalIntent.goal: Investigate local branch material and learn the actual shelter requirements.
personalIntent.reason: A nearby tree has accessible branch stock, but observation alone established no structural properties.
personalIntent.progress: Observed branch stock 9 at tick 6; two safe roots remain carried.
personalIntent.next: Gather two branches, press a small sample, recover energy, and consult the shelter contract at the meeting location.

shown.uncertainty: Branch material properties and the detailed construction requirements remain unknown.
shown.goal: Obtain a measured material finding and read the existing construction contract before proposing construction.

shown: Observation of branch stock did not establish structural suitability.

members.name: Cedar 4
members.intention: Recover from harvesting and investigate renewable food supplies without assuming regrowth.

personalIntent.goal: Maintain a safe food reserve and investigate sustainable local food production.
personalIntent.reason: Two safe roots are carried, health is full, and the harvested plant has only three roots remaining; replenishment has not been observed.
personalIntent.progress: Gathered three roots, ate one, and observed the remaining source stock at tick 5.
personalIntent.next: Recover energy, then request a practical way to investigate and support replenishment of the existing food plant.

evidence: At tick 5, collective-cedar-4-root had stock 3 of capacity 6 and was mature.

Two harvested roots remain in inventory; root nutrition is known as 14 with zero toxicity.
shown.uncertainty: No replenishment or benefit from plant care has yet been observed.
shown.goal: Discover a reusable, physically grounded way to maintain local food supplies.
completedSteps: Harvested three roots and consumed one.
Observed the harvested source at tick 5.
shown.missing: A known method for assessing and supporting replenishment.
shown.next: Request a feasible plant-care capability with explicit conditions and costs.

shown: Replenishment is unconfirmed; stock capacity alone does not prove regrowth.
Current health is 100, satiety 89.5, and two safe roots are carried.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and investigate protection from outdoor exposure.
personalIntent.reason: Currently outdoors with no known shelter or construction ability.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, eat, and request a feasible protective resting place.

shown: Exposure is observed, but present weather has caused no observed injury.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and make a short, cautious exploration.
personalIntent.reason: Known roots provide a reserve before moving toward the nearby eastern terrain edge.
personalIntent.progress: Healthy with no inventory; no local hazards observed.
